description.narrative:
The purpose of the assignment is to provide financial consultancy support to KLIMA. KLIMA has identified six engagements where a financial monitoring visit need be conducted. KLIMA will need consultancy support to carry out three of the visits as the Finance Hub in KLIMA consists of relatively new colleagues who do not yet have the experience in conducting financial monitoring visits.
The consultant will support with the following outputs:
- Prepare 3 financial monitoring visits to be conducted during 2025 - Conduct 3 on-site financial monitoring visits of grantees incl. necessary visits to sub grantees/local partners - Prepare a report for each financial monitoring visits which clearly outline observations and findings and which include recommendations in relation to any findings identified during the financial monitoring visit. - Present observations, findings and recommendations to grantee and MFA-staff for possible feedback and inclusion in the final report for the financial monitoring visit.
